name: domain.synthetic_generator
description: Schema-constrained synthetic mock dataset and time-series generator

entrypoints.name: generate_mock_records
entrypoints.description: Generate synthetic tabular records conforming to a schema definition (name, email, uuid, integer, float, enum)

entrypoints.name: generate_synthetic_timeseries
entrypoints.description: Generate synthetic daily time-series values with trend, seasonality, and Gaussian noise

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Number of days of data to generate (default: 30)
